tasks.description: Add a 'Forgot password?' link on the login page that opens a form for users to request a password reset. The link should be visible and accessible from the login page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address is displayed.

tasks.summary: Create email template for reset link
tasks.description: Design and implement an email template that includes a reset link containing a unique token. The email should be clear and instruct the user on the next steps.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when an email is sent to their registered email address, then the email contains a reset link with a unique token.

tasks.description: On request, generate a single-use, time-limited reset token and email it to the user's registered email address. Ensure the token is properly secured and can be validated later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when a reset token is generated, then the token is single-use, time-limited, and emailed to the user's registered email address.

tasks.description: Create a reset form where users can enter and confirm a new password. The form should validate the reset token before accepting the new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user clicks the reset link from their email, when they enter and confirm a new password, then the password is updated if the token is valid and not expired.

tasks.description: Hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme after a successful reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the new password is saved, then it is hashed and stored using the existing password-hashing scheme.

tasks.description: After a successful password reset, invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when they try to use an existing session token, then the token is no longer valid and they are prompted to log in again.

tasks.description: Validate the reset token before accepting the new password, rejecting expired, already-used, or invalid tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user tries to reset their password with an expired or already-used token, when they submit the reset form, then the reset is rejected and an error message is displayed.
